farm: GEM Global Wind Power Tracker (baseline, 10 MW threshold)

value.licence: CC BY 4.0 (data; already used by the site)

note_zh: GEM 方法頁：追蹤 10 MW 以上的專案分期，低於門檻的只在部分國家收錄——中印缺口的一部分是門檻以下與分散式風電。
note_en: GEM methodology: tracks project phases above 10 MW; below-threshold phases only for some countries — part of the China/India gap is sub-threshold and distributed wind.

sources.quote: The Global Wind Power Tracker aims to comprehensively track all project phases larger than 10MW globally. Below threshold projects are also included for some countries.
